title: Add retry backoff to auth
why: Transient upstream failures currently bubble straight to users.
what: Wrap outbound calls in src/auth/client.js with exponential backoff — 3 attempts, 200ms base.

title: Cache hot reads in the session store
why: The same lookups hammer the DB on every request; p50 suffers.
what: Add a 30s in-process LRU in front of src/sessions/store.js reads; invalidate on write.
notes: surfaced via post-commit discovery scan on commit 36d56b7

title: Batch writes in auth
why: Row-at-a-time writes dominate the flamegraph under load.
what: Buffer writes in src/auth/writer.js and flush every 100 rows or 50ms, whichever first.

title: Migrate webhooks config to the shared loader
why: It still reads env vars ad hoc; every other module uses the typed loader.
what: Replace process.env reads in src/webhooks/config.js with the shared loader and defaults.

title: Debounce duplicate events in i18n
why: Upstream sends bursts; we process the same event several times.
what: Key events by idempotency token in src/i18n/consumer.js; drop repeats inside a 60s window.

title: Instrument i18n with latency histograms (phase 2)
why: We only have averages today; p99 regressions go unnoticed.

title: Cache hot reads in the session store (phase 2)
why: The same lookups hammer the DB on every request; p50 suffers.
what: Add a 30s in-process LRU in front of src/sessions/store.js reads; invalidate on write.

title: Add retry backoff to onboarding (phase 3)
why: Transient upstream failures currently bubble straight to users.
what: Wrap outbound calls in src/onboarding/client.js with exponential backoff — 3 attempts, 200ms base.

title: Document the the admin dashboard failure modes (phase 2)
why: On-call keeps rediscovering the same edge cases from scratch.
what: Write src/admin/RUNBOOK.md covering the three known failure modes and their signals.

title: Tighten error messages in onboarding (phase 3)
why: Current errors leak internals and confuse support tickets.
what: Map internal errors to user-facing codes in src/onboarding/errors.js; log the detail, return the code.

title: Harden input validation in the admin dashboard (phase 2)
why: Malformed payloads reach the handler layer and 500 instead of 400.
what: Add schema validation at the boundary in src/admin/routes.js; reject early with field-level errors.

title: Fix timezone handling in onboarding (phase 2)
why: Dates render off-by-one for users west of UTC.
what: Store UTC in src/onboarding/serialize.js and convert at the render edge only.

title: Fix pagination drift in exports
why: Page boundaries shift when rows are inserted mid-scroll; duplicates show up.
what: Switch src/exports/query.js from offset to keyset pagination on (created_at, id).
